title: I recently learned to play the harmonica
excerpt: Three weeks, one blues scale and very patient neighbours.
body:
I bought a harmonica on a whim, mostly because it fits in a pocket and doesn't need to be plugged in.

Three weeks in, I can play one blues scale, two songs badly and one song almost well. The hardest part isn't the notes. It's breathing *in* on purpose, which feels wrong every single time.

My neighbours have been very patient. I've started practising with the windows closed.
